subject: planner: limit pushdown shouldn't be affected by tidb_opt_limit_push_down_threshold (#63399)
summary: Reviewed planner-only change in `pkg/planner/core/exhaust_physical_plans.go`: `pushLimitOrTopNForcibly` now takes the physical plan so a `LogicalTopN` implemented as `PhysicalLimit` always “meets threshold” (i.e. Limit pushdown preference is no longer disabled by `tidb_opt_limit_push_down_threshold` in that path), and the return order now matches `applyLogicalTopNAndLimitHint`’s `hintPrefer, meetThreshold` usage. No Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantics, or session/transaction behavior issues found.
